scope: All eight ordered direct e/mu assignments, both charges, six on-shell prescriptions. Five or more independently retrained runs per prediction; no flavour rescaling or grid imports.
precision: Accuracy is an initial allocation on the total rate, not fiducial/shape certification. Measure between-retraining variance and freeze common bins after full flavour coverage. Require sub-percent fiducial errors and 1--2% retained populated shapes, or explicit sensitivity.
remaining_scope: BW/massive companions, parameter/PDF-family/alpha-s/mass/13.6-TeV scans, coefficient attribution where resolved, final figures and paper remain required.
